references.text: Joshua gives instructions to choose three men from each tribe to survey the land, which is the immediate context for verse 8
Joshua mentions that he will cast lots for them before the Lord, a point repeated in verse 8
Joshua cast lots for them at Shiloh before the Lord, fulfilling what was promised in verse 8
The land is to be distributed by casting lots, an earlier command to use lots for dividing the land
Instruction to distribute the land by lot according to the tribes, which Joshua now carries out
Earlier distribution of land by lot in Canaan, establishing the practice that Joshua follows
The lot is cast into the lap, but the decision comes from the Lord—the same principle of the Lord's guidance over the casting of lots
Summary that the distribution took place by casting lots at Shiloh at the entrance to the tent of meeting before the Lord
